nameEn: Manufacture of imitation jewellery and related articles
description: This class includes the manufacture of jewellery and related articles of base metals plated with precious metals or other materials.
includes: manufacture of imitation jewellery: rings, bracelets, necklaces, brooches, earrings made of base metal, plastics, glass, etc.
manufacture of jewellery of base metal clad with precious metal
manufacture of jewellery of cut or moulded glass, plastics, shells, amber, bone, coral
manufacture of metal watch bands (except precious metal)
excludes: manufacture of jewellery of precious metal or precious/semi-precious stones, see 3211
manufacture of buttons, buckles, and other notions, see 3290
